The decoder now keeps a nested struct's pre-set defaults when its YAML node is null or holds only comments. In your example, `test.Defaults.Key` stays "My default Value".

The change is in `createDecodedNewValue` in `decode.go`. For a null node it used to always return the zero value. It now returns the existing value when the target is a struct and a default is present. Null into non-struct types still produces the zero value.

I added a regression test, `TestNullKeepsDefault`, in a new file `nulldef_test.go`. The package tests pass with `go test -vet=off .`. Plain `go test ./...` fails to build the root package because `go vet` flags malformed example names in the existing test files, such as `Example_YAMLTags` in `decode_test.go`. I didn't touch those.
